title: Mysuru Dasara & Jambu Savari
description: Official ten-day state festival (Nada Habba) centered at Amba Vilas Palace, culminating in the Vijayadashami Jambu Savari procession showcasing Karnataka's folk ensembles.
altText: Amba Vilas (Mysore Palace) illuminated in warm gold lights at dusk during Mysuru Dasara.
historicalBackground: Recognized by the Government of Karnataka Department of Kannada and Culture as the state festival, continuing centuries-old royal Navaratri observance traditions.

title: Pattadakal Chalukya Dance Festival
description: Cultural dance and music festival hosted against the sandstone temple backdrop of UNESCO-listed Pattadakal along the Malaprabha River.
altText: Sandstone Chalukyan cliff and temple architecture in Bagalkot district, Karnataka.
historicalBackground: Organized by the Government of Karnataka to celebrate Early Chalukyan architectural heritage at Pattadakal, Badami, and Aihole.
